items.reason: The source addresses the Southern Ute Indian Tribe. The Ute Mountain Ute Tribe and Ute Indian Tribe of the Uintah and Ouray Reservation are distinct governments.
The Tribe’s May 11 release reports the signing and limits the authority to covered actions on reservation land held in trust for the Tribe. Interior corroborates the scope.
